name: Porphyry of Tyre
contribution: A Phoenician Neoplatonic philosopher born in Tyre, Roman Phoenicia during Roman rule.

checks.lead: Porphyry (; Koine Greek: Πορφύριος, romanized: Porphýrios; c. 234 – c. 305) was a Phoenician Neoplatonic philosopher born in Tyre, Roman Phoenicia during Roman rule. He edited and published the Enneads, the only collection of the work of Plotinus, his teacher.
